facts.value: Explore the diverse range of opportunities for international students at Goethe University and shape your own academic path.

Whether it’s a semester abroad, an ERASMUS program, an internship, or work in research and teaching – spending time abroad opens up countless new opportunities and horizons for your personal and professional development.
Goethe University maintains partnerships with over 450 universities across Europe and around the world.
It promotes international exchange among students as well as international research, thereby strengthening global networking.
Internationality shapes our research, our programs, and our campus – at Goethe University, we are all international.
Goethe University's Internationalization is based on a collaboratively developed strategy that guides our actions and university-wide development across all faculties.
